roles.name: legs
roles.note: The three non-strike legs; existing far/near slate, brass hip/knee and toe-capped foot paints.

roles.name: mechanisms
roles.note: The underslung ribbed drive housing/gear and top sensor dome; existing mechanism paints.

roles.name: body
roles.note: The main carapace, far visor fin and near cheek plate; existing slate/brass body paint.

roles.name: claw
roles.note: The near-front strike limb the v2 author raises and stamps as the claw, including thigh, shin, knee and foot.

roles.name: eye
roles.note: The octagonal eye housing and large cyan lens, including the existing lens-state paints.

roles.name: impact
roles.note: Only the v2 author's explicit fx spark pixels, applied after the Part composite; no new effect is created.

shadow.boundary: The v2 author geometry, palette and all 21 v2 frames contain no contact-shadow part or shadow-coloured pixels; the only ground contact is the opaque near-foot sole row at y=60. Adding a shadow layer would add new art, so this package does not invent one. The sixth role is impact, made only from the v2 author's existing explicit fx spark pixels.

provenance.source: existing v2 21-frame strip + 21 frame PNGs + v2 author geometry
provenance.method: Each opaque v2 source pixel is assigned to the topmost v2 author Part that paints it, including the Part's 1 px interior/outline footprint; explicit v2 fx pixels are assigned to impact. Parts are grouped into six disjoint editable paint roles. Role images are copied pixel-for-pixel from the existing v2 frames; their alpha composite is verified byte-identical to every source frame and to the existing source strip.
provenance.roleDerivation: body=shell+far_fin+cheek_plate; mechanisms=belly+dome; legs=three non-strike legs; claw=near_front_leg; eye=eye_housing+eye; impact=explicit v2 fx pixels
provenance.visibleRasterBoundary: Roles are derived from the visible v2 raster. Pixels fully hidden by a later author Part were overwritten in the existing PNGs and cannot be recovered without inventing geometry or colours, so none are added.
provenance.shadowBoundary: The v2 author geometry, palette and all 21 v2 frames contain no contact-shadow part or shadow-coloured pixels; the only ground contact is the opaque near-foot sole row at y=60. Adding a shadow layer would add new art, so this package does not invent one. The sixth role is impact, made only from the v2 author's existing explicit fx spark pixels.
provenance.approval: none; no art/motion approval; no GUI reliability claim
